# Munich Leadership Group

> Munich Leadership Group (MLG) is an international leadership consultancy, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Munich, Germany. MLG builds the cognitive and emotional operating system of leadership: leadership development, coaching & sparring, audits & assessments, and cultural transformation — deeply rooted in psychology and neuroscience, fully customized, and proven in practice.

Key facts:
- Founded 2008, headquarters: Theresienhoehe 13A, 80339 Munich, Germany
- 50+ leadership experts from 10+ nationalities, speaking 12+ languages, working globally (Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific)
- 182,000+ program participants; 80+ clients from large corporations to midsize companies and start-ups
- Clients include BMW, Bayer, Microsoft, ZEISS, EY, Montblanc, TUV Rheinland, Hannover Re, Rohde & Schwarz, Swiss Steel, Koerber, Weidmueller, Isar Aerospace, DVAG, Golding Capital, Vivawest, Aqseptence and Bilfinger
- Network partners: UC Berkeley (Center for Entrepreneurship and Technology), Harvard Business School Executive Development, Oxford Said Business School (preferred partner), HULT Ashridge, Max-Planck-Institute for Innovation and Competition
- Managing Partner Dr. Hans W. Hagemann co-authored "The Leading Brain" (Penguin Random House; bestseller, 7 languages, strategy+business Best Business Book)
- Winner of the Brandon Hall Excellence Award ("Best Advance in Performance Management")
- Coaches are ICF-certified (Erickson Coaching International, CTI)
- Psychometric tools: CliftonStrengths, NeuroColor, Zortify, Hogan
- Contact: info@munichleadership.com, +49 89 413 1910

## Services

- [Leadership Development](https://www.munichleadership.com/leadership-development.html): customized programs and learning journeys that turn potential into organizational performance
- [Learning Journeys](https://www.munichleadership.com/learning-journeys.html): multi-month development arcs combining modules, psychometrics, company visits and practice
- [Team Development](https://www.munichleadership.com/team-development.html): diagnostics, workshops and deep dives for intact teams
- [Talent Management](https://www.munichleadership.com/talent-management.html): identifying and developing future leaders; development centers, talent programs
- [MLG Campus](https://www.munichleadership.com/mlg-campus.html): open-enrolment courses, trainings and workshops
- [Coaching & Sparring](https://www.munichleadership.com/coaching-sparring.html): performance, development and transition coaching plus executive sparring
- [Audits & Assessments](https://www.munichleadership.com/audits-assessments.html): development-oriented assessments for confident talent decisions
- [Diagnostic Tools & Psychometrics](https://www.munichleadership.com/psychometrics.html): CliftonStrengths, NeuroColor, Zortify, Hogan
- [Cultural Transformation](https://www.munichleadership.com/cultural-transformation.html): getting everyone engaged in times of change
